 Canadiens at Rangers projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 16, 2026 
 Link copied 
 CANADIENS (12-4-4) at RANGERS (12-8-1) 
 7:30 p.m. ET; HBO MAX, truTV, TNT, SN+, TVAS 
 Canadiens projected lineup 
 Cole Caufield -- Nick Suzuki -- Juraj Slafkovsky
 Zachary Bolduc -- Phillip Danault -- Alexandre Texier
 Florian Xhekaj -- Jake Evans -- Owen Beck
 Alex Newhook -- Oliver Kapanen -- Kirby Dach
 Lane Hutson -- Noah Dobson
 Kaiden Guhle -- Alexandre Carrier
 Arber Xhekaj -- Adam Engstrom
 Jacob Fowler
 Jakub Dobes
 Scratched: David Reinbacher, Brett Berard 
 Injured: Chris Kreider (lower body), Josh Anderson (lower body), Mike Matheson (lower body), Samuel Montembeault (lower body), Ivan Demidov (lower body) 
 Rangers projected lineup 
 Gabe Perreault -- Mika Zibanejad -- Alexis Lafreniere
 Tye Kartye -- J.T. Miller -- Pavel Dorofeyev
 Will Cuylle -- Noah Laba -- Oliver Bjorkstrand
 Eeli Tolvanen -- Glenn Gawdin -- Jaroslav Chmelar
 Vladislav Gavrikov -- Adam Fox
 Marcus Pettersson -- Braden Schneider
 Matthew Robertson -- Scott Morrow
 Joonas Korpisalo
 Dylan Garand
 Scratched: Matt Rempe, Marc Del Gaizo, Luke Glendening 
 Injured: Igor Shesterkin (lower body), Joseph Veleno (lower body), Alberts Smits (upper body), Sean Durzi (undisclosed) 
 Status report 
 The Canadiens recalled Reinbacher, a defenseman, from Laval of the American Hockey League on Sunday, and Berard, a forward, on Monday. … Anderson, a forward, is out 3-4 weeks, and Matheson, a defenseman, 2-3 weeks. … Dorofeyev is expected to play after leaving practice early Sunday for an undisclosed reason. He was on the ice for an optional morning skate Monday, and Rangers coach Mike Sullivan said he doesn't anticipate any issues with his availability.
